description: Fast-lane role routing: which team role takes part in a task, and when. A rule matches a task of one of its kinds when any trigger hits: the task size, a file the task names or changes (shell globs, * crosses /), or a keyword in its title or text (whole word, plural allowed). mode require blocks open-pr until the role's verdict is recorded; suggest never blocks; off drops a packaged rule. step pre_check is a bounded review of the task and its plan before writing; author means the role writes the change. A project replaces a rule of the same role, or adds one, in .agentrof/role-routing.json with the same rules shape.

rules.ask: Check the task and its plan against the architecture records and the solution design: data model and schema changes, module and service boundaries, public interfaces and contracts, cross-component dependencies. Return go, or changes with a reason for each; a finding that is not critical becomes an issue instead of a change.
Check the task against the solution landscape and its decision log: product choice, integration and runtime placement. Return go, or changes with a reason for each.
Check the acceptance criteria against the approved analysis: business rules, process steps and edge cases. Return go, or changes with a reason for each.
Check that each acceptance criterion has a named test that proves it, and name the live group the change can affect. Return go, or changes with a reason for each.
